ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win
imanaga.blurb: Griffin Conine hits a go-ahead single in the 12th inning and Kyle Stowers homers in the Marlins' 8-2 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win
suzuki.blurb: Griffin Conine hits a go-ahead single in the 12th inning and Kyle Stowers homers in the Marlins' 8-2 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Pete Alonso's two-homer game powers Orioles to win
okamoto.blurb: Pete Alonso crushes a pair of home runs, including an 8th-inning go-ahead smash to give the Orioles a 4-3 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: White Sox power four homers in 14-11 win over Royals
murakami.blurb: Brenton Doyle, Chase Meidroth, Randal Grichuk and Munetaka Murakami each hit a home run in the White Sox 14-11 win over the Royals

matsui.title: Ethan Salas walks it off in 7-6 Padres win
matsui.blurb: A two-RBI night from Samad Taylor and a walk-off single from Ethan Salas propel the Padres to a 7-6 extra-inning win over the Marlins
